_doc: [home] The Verdance system: one binary star, the single source of truth for every sky (systems/solar_system.gd SolarSystem.suns_for(planet_id)). star_a is the warm primary (carries shadows), star_b the smaller cooler companion (unshadowed warm fill). size = angular size multiplier (1 = the primary as seen from Verdance), energy = light multiplier; both scale with orbital distance as size / orbit_au and energy / orbit_au^2 (clamped by min_energy / max_energy). Per planet: orbit_au (distance; display order on the solar map), tilt_deg (axial tilt), sep_deg (angular separation of the two suns), sep_angle_deg (direction of the companion from the primary across the sky, 0 = trailing along the sun path, 90 = toward the zenith), day_length_s (game seconds), moons (decorative, owned by each planet env: name, size, color, orbit). Rime is farthest: two small points, weak day light, stars visible by day (day_stars).
